description: Get one saved reply with its message as written, merge fields and all. One in another workspace answers 404. To start a campaign step from it, copy `subject` and `body` into the step with update_campaign_step (`body` as `bodyText`, with `bodyHtml: ""` on a step that has a formatted part; a subject over the step's limit answers 400). The step keeps its own copy: editing or deleting the saved reply later doesn't change it.
name: get_saved_reply
title: Get a saved reply
